candidate_source: post-score-outcomes.csv, horizon_h=6; one row per valid post-score entry; 17 unique entries
entry_rule: first completed 1m close at or after archived score publication; entry at that close; exclude a candidate if the original wick stop was touched before entry
stop: original touch 5m wick low for long or high for short, no buffer
control: no fixed take profit; original wick stop or 6h close
target_tick_rounding: outward to a valid OKX tick so the nominal minimum percentage is not reduced
ohlc_execution: native monday_wick_r_engine.first_hit; observed open precedence; original stop before TP on an ambiguous same-minute double touch; market stop gaps fill at the observed open
slot_rule: Each target scenario is replayed independently. Sort by post-score entry time, then symbol alphabetically, then signal ID. Accept an entry only when its entry_ms is strictly greater than the prior position exit_ms; same-time candidates are resolved alphabetically.
sizing: Each accepted trade is normalized to 1 quote-currency unit of reference entry notional for VectorBT accounting; no compounding or capital-path claim.
data_access: Read-only local 1m OHLC gzip cache referenced by the source selection.csv. No API requests or online writes.
vectorbt: isolated local vectorbt-python environment; Portfolio.from_orders; independent trade columns after single-slot schedule filtering
